protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias, not fixed weights or verified training cutoff
protocol.aggregation: Each month/repeat separately, equal cell average; Q9 headline-style center is median of individually fitted density means, not a nationwide headline.
protocol.auxiliary_weights: Original SCE weight multiplied by within-parent stratum inverse inclusion probability; main paired analysis unweighted and equal-month. Neither implies national representativeness.
protocol.sampling: Reuse fixed 24-person cognition roster:14 High and10 Low; Low oversampled; not a national or Q1-stratified sample. No current inflation answer used for selection.
protocol.update_mae_identity: Against the same observed prior, individual update absolute error equals current individual density-mean absolute error algebraically; these are not independent successes.
protocol.comparison: Facts minus baseline changes the Q1 information package. Perspective minus facts adds only a non-directional household-viewpoint instruction. No invented events or coefficient offsets.
protocol.primary_direction: Smaller is better; all intervals exploratory paired person-cluster bootstrap.
protocol.intervals: 1000 paired person-cluster draws retaining all months and both generations; equal month/repeat cells; no confirmatory multiplicity claim.
guardrails: valid_fraction >= 0.99 and scorable_fraction >= 0.99 in every arm
protocol.candidate_gate: Detailed-vs-baseline individual-density-mean-MAE upper exploratory95% bound<0, center and W1 point changes<=0, all-arm coverage>=99%. Pilot continuation only.
protocol.support: All three arms and both repeats scorable for a retained person-month; report human missingness separately from model failures. Q8 support separate.
protocol.financial_groups: Current Q1 worse=1/2, same=3, better=4/5. Same-person group medians compared with real groups per month/repeat; suppress a gap if either group has fewer than3 common people. Five codes descriptive only.
protocol.truth_isolation: Preparation projects only date/userid/financial_change from hash-verified cache; no current Q8/Q9 parsed. Runtime receives anonymous Q1 sidecar, existing P/E and observed historical prior only.
protocol.information_boundary: Current Q1 is contemporaneous private household assessment, explicit A auxiliary condition; public E retains existing cutoff. Does not certify Q1 or prior answers as available inputs to real-time B.
protocol.old_direct_reference: Old identical baseline messages may be compared descriptively; all primary arms are newly generated contemporaneously.
limits: Four inspected development months; not independent validation.
Q1 is subjective finances relative to12 months earlier; adjacent category shifts are not measured month-on-month income shocks.
Current Q1 can itself reflect inflation beliefs; not a causal Q1 experiment or strict B forecast.
Prompt length and explicit instruction effects cannot be separated from household-memory mechanisms by this pilot alone.
24-person fixed roster has only2 much-worse person-months; no claim for that subgroup or national representativeness.
Two generations are model variability, not additional respondents or a provider-enforced RNG seed.
Observed and model raw Q9 use the same frozen approximate fitter; official derived fields auxiliary only.

individual_update_mae_identity.scope: On the same finite matched real previous belief, individual-update MAE equals current density-mean MAE exactly. It is one piece of evidence; distributional delta-W1 is a different descriptive quantity.

kernel_migration.equivalence_check: 3,741 sealed holdout rows recomputed; zero per-field difference

scorer_provenance.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

q9_mean.interpretation: Sensitivity diagnostic only; official summary fields do not replace ten-bin truth or frozen-scorer metrics.

q9_iqr.interpretation: Sensitivity diagnostic only; official summary fields do not replace ten-bin truth or frozen-scorer metrics.

human_truth_scoring: Human and model ten-bin Q9 vectors use the same frozen approximate scorer; official summary fields are sensitivity diagnostics only.

common_support.support_definition: Each retained person-month has valid answers in all three arms and both repeats, finite matched frozen Q9 mean/IQR/zero and raw bins; Q8 has its own legal all-arm/all-repeat finite-point mask. Missing and invalid cases remain in assigned coverage counts.

aggregation: Equal month × repeat cells; paired globally clustered respondent bootstrap retains every sampled person’s months and repeats. Repeated generations are not new humans.

sampling_design.primary_analysis: Unweighted within selected roster; equal month and repeat cells; not nationally representative.
sampling_design.auxiliary_weighting: Parent survey weight × inverse selection probability, descriptive sensitivity only.

auxiliary_survey_weighted.weight_definition: Parent SCE survey weight × parent-stratum size / selected-stratum size; descriptive sensitivity only.
Parent SCE survey weight × parent-stratum size / selected-stratum size; descriptive sensitivity only.
Parent SCE survey weight × parent-stratum size / selected-stratum size; descriptive sensitivity only.

financial_group_descriptions.sparse_cell_rule: Do not report a group contrast if either group has fewer than 3 common people; full-sample accuracy retains those people.
financial_group_descriptions.interpretation: Differences between group medians compared with the matched human median gap; not causal effects or independent validation.

financial_facts_minus_baseline.scope: Exploratory unadjusted respondent-cluster bootstrap; all months and both repeats remain together; equal month-repeat cells.

financial_perspective_minus_financial_fa.scope: Exploratory unadjusted respondent-cluster bootstrap; all months and both repeats remain together; equal month-repeat cells.

financial_perspective_minus_baseline.scope: Exploratory unadjusted respondent-cluster bootstrap; all months and both repeats remain together; equal month-repeat cells.

financial_facts_minus_baseline.interpretation: Exploratory continuation screen only; no automatic default upgrade or confirmed mechanism claim.

financial_perspective_minus_financial_fa.interpretation: Exploratory continuation screen only; no automatic default upgrade or confirmed mechanism claim.

financial_perspective_minus_baseline.interpretation: Exploratory continuation screen only; no automatic default upgrade or confirmed mechanism claim.

primary_continuation_gate.interpretation: Exploratory continuation screen only; no automatic default upgrade or confirmed mechanism claim.

limitations: Current Q1 and inflation answers were collected in the same survey. This is A historical conditional reconstruction, not B ex ante forecasting or a causal financial-shock estimate.
Four previously inspected development months, numeracy-stratified roster and few extreme financial states; no independent validation or national inference.
Public information, earlier beliefs and price news are held fixed across arms. Financial facts and household-perspective wording remain exploratory interventions.
Group comparisons are descriptive; groups with fewer than 3 common respondents in a cell are suppressed without deleting full-sample rows.
Accuracy conditions on common legal/scorable support; assigned counts retain invalid and missing cases.
